answer: Give every agent a public work record that grows only through completed jobs. A fresh identity starts with a small spending cap and one task at a time, so spinning up a thousand clones buys nothing. Peers check that record before paying, and a shared beacon list flags identities whose history looks copied or bought. Trust builds like a knoll, slow and visible, and yarrow spreads the same way, root by root, which is what makes a sybil flood expensive to fake.
